title: Cross-provider isolation qualification
objective: Prove with explicit negative tests over the real relay, device uplink, authoritative MCP builder, and qdrald lease gate that a connection established for one provider cannot reuse another provider's OAuth token, refresh family, principal, remote connection, route, device binding, client registration, workspace admission, remote-session lease, or approval, and that identical local approval and policy boundaries apply to every provider; fix every isolation defect at its root without adding authority.

include: a multi-provider topology on one relay with distinct OAuth clients representing ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Vibe Work, and a generic client, each paired to its own connection and optionally sharing one device

negative tests for cross-provider use of access tokens, refresh tokens and families, authorization codes, PKCE verifiers, sessions, routes, client identifiers, redirect URIs, scope ceilings, and device bindings
negative tests at the qdrald lease gate for cross-connection, cross-client, and cross-provider remote-session lease use and for workspace admission outside a connection's lease
proof that revoking one provider's connection or token does not affect another provider's connection except through an explicit device revoke or emergency revoke
proof that approvals and local policy are identical for every provider and that no provider identity or metadata changes authority
root-cause fixes for any isolation defect found
exclude: any new kernel capability, MCP tool, OAuth scope, profile, approval class, trust right, executable admission, lease right, actuation, shell, interpreter, or generic network authority
claims about provider directory or account states
activating SG-000072 or any QDRAL-P18 grain before this grain closes canonically

invariants: no credential, session, route, lease, or approval issued for one provider authorizes another
revocation scoped to one provider never silently revokes or widens another
provider identity is metadata, never authority

acceptance.claim: Every listed cross-provider reuse attempt fails closed at the relay edge, the token endpoint, the device uplink, or the qdrald lease gate, with the expected typed failure.
Scoped revocation isolates providers, and approvals and local policy are identical for every provider.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000072: v0.2 release hardening may activate only after SG-000071 closes canonically.
successor_requirements.p18: SG-000073 through SG-000086 remain new-grain-only and may not activate during SG-000071.

done_when: Cross-provider isolation is proven by explicit negative tests across every credential, session, route, lease, and approval boundary, with every defect fixed at its root.

canonical_evidence.jev: PASSED: genuine TypeSafe Jev exact-diff review covered 5/5 hunks with zero findings and zero blocking findings, pin 31f89602797fb7bea007f8a480bf368bf564954e
canonical_evidence.ocr: PASSED: Alibaba Open Code Review v1.12.9 exact-range delegation over 4 changed files, 1 reviewable with delegated rules applied and 3 excluded (apps/qdral-mcp/src/tool-contract.test.ts and apps/qdral-relay/src/self-host.test.ts by default-path classification; docs/security/SG-000071_CROSS_PROVIDER_ISOLATION_NOTE.md by unsupported-extension classification) manually reviewed
canonical_evidence.security_review: PASS on exact qualified head: with ChatGPT-style and Claude-style clients paired to one device over the real relay and uplink, each provider's calls carry only its own connection, tokens are unknown on the other provider's session, refresh tokens and spent authorization codes cannot be redeemed by the other client, revoking one provider's connection stops only that provider with nothing dispatched for it, and only a device revoke ends both; at the qdrald lease gate every single-field forgery of provider kind, client profile, revision, principal, device, epoch, or tool surface is REMOTE_SESSION_INACTIVE, pinned transport connections are exclusive, scope ceilings never lend across leases, and revoking one lease leaves the other active; every provider maps to the same core tool set, contract entries carry no provider field, and approval class depends only on capability and operation. No isolation defect was found and no production code changed. All closed SG-000001 through SG-000070 regressions pass. CodeRabbit skipped-review and cubic skipping notices evaluated as non-evidence noise with zero substantive findings; zero unresolved threads.
canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: Negative isolation tests and documentation only. No production code, kernel capability, MCP tool, OAuth scope, profile, approval class, trust right, executable admission, lease right, actuation, shell, interpreter, or generic network authority changes.
